entities.name: Forging the Blackblade
entities.description: Event in the Time of Legends in which Dakkon forged the Blackblade for Dihada.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A master blacksmith and warrior who became a planeswalker, his soul bound into the Blackblade.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Planeswalker who had Dakkon forge the Blackblade and then bound his soul into it.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-drinker blade forged by Dakkon for Dihada.

entities.name: Sivitri's War
entities.description: War after which Dihada visited Dakkon.

entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: Event in which Dihada conquered southern Corondor for three centuries.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Plane conquered by Dihada in the south.

events.summary: Dihada offered to make Dakkon a planeswalker if he forged her the Blackblade.
events.quote: offered to make him a planeswalker if he would make her the most powerful blade in existence

events.summary: Dakkon forged the blade over ten years, killing a slave each time he heated it, and completed it.
events.quote: Finally, the blade was completed, and Dakkon could not help but test it.

events.summary: Dakkon waded into battle and was named Dakkon Blackblade.
Dihada made him a planeswalker but plunged the Blackblade into his shadow, binding his soul into the blade.
events.quote: she bound his soul into the blade as his planeswalker spark ignited

events.summary: Dihada spent three centuries conquering southern Corondor while Dakkon searched for her.
events.quote: Dihada spent three centuries conquering southern Corondor while Dakkon wandered the planes searching for her.

relations.quote: he would make her the most powerful blade in existence
only to make him her enemy
